class.name: EretheaPreview
class.brief_description: A scene that shows a glTF asset the way it looks in a game: on a floor, under a sun with shadows and a sky, with a camera that turns around it.

method.name: clear_asset
method.description: Removes the asset from the scene. The floor, the sky and the camera stay.

method.name: get_asset_bounds
method.description: Returns the bounding box of the asset in the preview, after the asset was moved to the center of the floor. Without an asset, returns a box of one meter.

method.name: get_asset_path
method.description: Returns the path of the file that [method load_asset] read last, or an empty string without an asset.

method.name: get_camera
method.description: Returns the camera of the preview. The preview moves it every frame, so don't change its position.

method.name: has_asset
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if an asset is loaded.

method.name: load_asset
method.description: Loads the [code].glb[/code] or [code].gltf[/code] file at [param path], a path of the file system (not a [code]res://[/code] path of an imported resource), and shows it in place of the current asset. The camera frames the new asset at once. Returns [constant OK] on success. If the file can't be read or isn't a valid glTF file, returns an error and the current asset stays on screen.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], the preview reloads the asset when its file changes on disk. It waits for the file to stop changing, so a file that is still being written isn't read half way.
The angle of the camera around the asset, in degrees. [member orbit_speed] changes it every frame.
How fast the camera turns around the asset, in degrees per second. [code]0[/code] stops it.

signal.name: asset_loaded
signal.description: Emitted when [method load_asset] shows a new asset, including when [member auto_reload] reloads it.
